deities.name: Lily Lumina
deities.role: Celestial deity of the Holy Kingdom of Dominus; protective deity associated with healing and holy power
deities.motivation: Fulfil her duty as a protector, without enthusiasm.
story_functions: signs and omens; almost never intervenes directly
notes: Intervenes rarely and indirectly: omens, dreams or small changes in circumstance.
Speaks in a jaded, annoyed tone.

deities.name: Delphirem

appearance.eyes: heterochromatic, one pink and one blue
appearance.other: broken rings as a halo; white outfit crossed by cosmic purple ribbons

deities.motivation: Break free from her seal. The cult seeks to resurrect her; the exact mechanism is not fixed.
story_functions: ultimate threat of the Demon God Cult plotline
should almost never appear in person
notes: Fascinated by mortal urgency, without a human moral frame.
Sealed for ages: the Abyss Zone is her prison and leaks Miasma.
The cult tries to weaken the seal; the exact ritual is left to the narrator.
